name: Verilog block: write, simulate, check
task: Describe the block to build, or name the spec file.

steps.name: Write the design
steps.task:
{task}

Write the design in {design}. Compile it and fix every error. Do not write a testbench.

steps.name: Write the testbench
steps.task:
{task}

Write a self-checking testbench in {tb} for the module in {design}. Read only its port list. Print one line starting with PASS or FAIL for each check and call $finish at the end. Do not change {design}.
